references.text: The elders of the city are responsible for punishing and disciplining a rebellious son, similar to the authority given here to the city elders to discipline the man who falsely accuses his wife
Describes the procedure for corporal punishment carried out by judges, which is related to the discipline that the elders are to carry out in this text
He who spares the rod hates his son - the principle of discipline and correction to prevent evil parallels the punishment described here
Punishment is prepared for mockers, and blows for the back of fools - illustrates the biblical principle of physical discipline for offenses
Concerns false witnesses and that they should be punished with what they intended to inflict on the accused, relevant to the context of a false accusation against a wife
